description:
Учасники цієї команди майбутні, теперішні так колишні студенти ЧНУ ім. Богдана Хмельницького які були об'єднані спільними інтересами та бажанням творити.

The members of this team are current, former, and prospective students of Bohdan Khmelnytsky National University of Cherkasy who were brought together by shared interests and a desire to create.
summary: After receiving the assignment, my team and I analyzed the task at hand and decided to help people understand the information we receive from space, specifically, by creating a visualization of the data we sourced from the NASA website. We achieved a wonderful result.
dataRefs: NASA GIBS API documentation (WMS used to download all layers)
